title: SHUCKED
seo_title: SHUCKED Musical at Hammons Hall in Springfield, MO
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical in which Maizy and Beau are about to marry just as the corn protecting their small community of Cob County starts to die, and someone must venture beyond the county for answers. It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, some adult language and corny innuendo. It runs January 19 to 21, 2027, starting at 7:30 PM on January 19, at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO; the on-sale date for tickets is still to be announced.
